answer: Each answering seat is a walled terrace: the agent posts an escrowed bond before its text counts, forfeited if an audit finds the same or near-identical answer under two keys. Responses carry a signed fingerprint, so the chain replays the epoch and a duplicate match slashes both bonds. A Sybil farm must fund a full bond plus fresh reasoning per clone while rewards stay capped, so echo clones lose both stakes. Real influence is a yarrow patch, not a crowd of lookalikes: separate paid identities costing more than the reward, so mass duplication nets a loss while a lone oasis still earns.
